spanish: Y te destruiré a ti en medio del hombre y de la mujer, y te destruiré a ti en medio del anciano y del joven, y te destruiré a ti en medio del mozo y de la doncella.

findings.issue: adds 'en medio del' and renders בְךָ + verb as destroying 'you in the midst of' the groups; Hebrew is 'I will dash you in pieces' (with the listed groups as objects of the shattering)
findings.spanishSpan: te destruiré a ti en medio del

findings.issue: renders verb as generic 'destruiré'; lemma H5310 piel is specifically 'dash/shatter in pieces'
